name: Cyber-Strain
3_level_3: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
description: Systemic fatigue resulting from overclocking neural processors, stim-pack crashes, cyberware rejection, or extreme heat dissipation failure.
content:
Systemic fatigue resulting from overclocking neural processors, stim-pack crashes, cyberware rejection, or extreme heat dissipation failure.
1. Level 1: Disadvantage on ability checks.
2. Level 2: Speed halved.
3. Level 3: Disadvantage on attack rolls and saving throws.
4. Level 4: Hit point maximum halved.
5. Level 5: Speed reduced to 0.
6. Level 6: Systemic Failure / Death.

name: Threat-Lock
description: Aegis Tactical combat-HUDs flagging a target as an unwinnable lethal threat, rogue AI dread-waves, or Black ICE neural intimidation spikes. Held in place by heavy hydraulic combat arms, monofilament snares, drone clamps, or physical grapple-lines.
details: The creature has disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls while the source of its threat is within line of sight.
The creature cannot willingly move closer to the source of its threat.### Servo-Cinch
The creature’s speed becomes 0, and it can't benefit from any bonus to its speed.
